stem.en: During online festival sales, the prices of many products are very low. Which explanation fits demand and supply best?

text.en: Only buyers gain, because sellers lose money on everything they sell.
Sellers have extra stock, and a lower price helps them sell more of it.
Prices are low because the demand for these products has fallen to zero.
The government fixes low prices for festivals, and sellers must follow.

explanation.en: At the usual price, sellers would be left with a surplus. A lower price makes buyers want more, so more is sold. Buyers pay less, and sellers sell all their stock and can still earn money, so both can gain.

hints.en: At the usual price, would the sellers sell all their stock?
